items.question: Is FuelX really lab-tested?
items.answer: Yes. Every single batch is tested by NABL-accredited independent labs. We publish full reports including protein content, amino acid profile, heavy metal analysis, and microbiological testing. Links are on every product page.

items.question: What's the difference between isolate and concentrate?
items.answer: Whey isolate goes through additional filtration to remove most fat and lactose, resulting in 90%+ protein content per scoop. Concentrate is typically 70-80%. Our Raw Whey Isolate delivers 25g of pure protein per 30g scoop — that's 83% protein by weight.

items.question: Will it cause bloating?
items.answer: Our DigeZyme enzyme blend (amylase, protease, lipase, cellulase, lactase) is specifically added to prevent bloating and digestive discomfort. 94% of our customers report zero digestive issues — even those who are mildly lactose sensitive.
